# PropertyTaxPeek

> US Property Tax Rates by State & County

Explore property tax rates for all 50 US states and 500+ counties. Compare effective tax rates, median property taxes, and home values. Free property tax calculator.

## Core pages
- [Methodology and data sources](https://propertytaxpeek.com/methodology/): how every figure is derived, with primary-source citations
- [Compare](https://propertytaxpeek.com/compare/): side-by-side comparison
- [About and editorial standards](https://propertytaxpeek.com/about/): authorship and review policy

## Data
- Primary sources: US Census Bureau — American Community Survey (ACS) 2024 5-Year, US Census Bureau — State & Local Government Finances, US Census Bureau — ACS 2024 5-Year
- All figures are derived from these primary sources; see /methodology/ for derivation and vintage.
